name: Flow tracers
summary: A NASA dataset (rain, ozone, carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides: pick it in the Data menu) with particles following its motion. Press Play: tracers over high values sing, higher values play higher and louder.
author: moran
description: Pick a dataset with the Data menu: NASA real-time precipitation (IMERG), or near-surface ozone, carbon monoxide or nitrogen oxides from NASA's GEOS-CF model. Streams of particles follow the apparent motion of that dataset's pattern (optical flow). Yellow tracers over high values (rain, or above-median gas) sing: a higher value plays higher and louder, west to east pans left to right, the instrument comes from the region. Only the chosen dataset is shown and heard.
